exams.name: National Council Licensure Examination (NCLEX)
exams.notes: NCLEX-RN for registered nurses, NCLEX-PN for practical nurses. Applicants who fail may retake no more frequently than once every 45 days for up to one year; after 3 years must requalify.
exams.quote: An applicant for initial licensure must pass the appropriate National Council Licensure Examination (NCLEX) prescribed by the board.

interval_years.quote: A license issued pursuant to this chapter may be renewed biennially or as otherwise provided by the board in regulation.

available.quote: An applicant for a license who currently holds or has held an authorization to practice nursing in another state or jurisdiction in this country or territory or dependency of the United States may be licensed by the board by endorsement, without examination

requirements.value: Licensure by endorsement without examination; applicant must have graduated from an approved nursing education program, submit verification of prior authorization to practice, demonstrate that license was issued based on NCLEX or SBTPE (or 3+ years without disciplinary restriction), and meet all other requirements including evidence of continued competency.
requirements.quote: may be licensed by the board by endorsement, without examination, if the applicant: ... submits verification of current or prior authorization to practice as a nurse in another state or jurisdiction

drug_authority.value: Licensed nurses may administer and deliver medications and treatments as prescribed by an authorized licensed provider. APRNs (NP, CNM, CNS) with prescriptive authority may prescribe noncontrolled and controlled substances (Schedules II-V with limitations) pursuant to a practice agreement. CRNAs may deliver anesthesia without separate prescriptive authority.
drug_authority.quote: may include Schedules III through V controlled substances if listed in the practice agreement and as authorized by Section 44-53-300

full_independent_practice_available.quote: A licensed NP, CNM, or CNS performing medical acts must do so pursuant to a practice agreement with a physician who must be readily available for consultation.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: The board shall issue an identification number to the NP, CNM, or CNS authorized to prescribe medications. Authorization for prescriptive authority is valid for two years unless terminated by the board for cause.

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: may include Schedules III through V controlled substances if listed in the practice agreement and as authorized by Section 44-53-300; may include Schedule II nonnarcotic substances if listed in the practice agreement ... may include Schedule II narcotic substances if listed in the practice agreement

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Schedule II narcotic prescriptions limited to 5-day supply, and another prescription may not be written without written agreement of the collaborating physician, unless patient is in hospice or palliative care or in a long-term care facility (in which case up to 30-day supply is permitted).
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: may include Schedule II narcotic substances if listed in the practice agreement and as authorized by Section 44-53-300, provided, however, that the prescription must not exceed a five-day supply and another prescription must not be written without the written agreement of the physician with whom the nurse practitioner, certified nurse-midwife, or clinical nurse specialist has entered into a practice agreement, unless the prescription is written for patients in hospice or palliative care or for patients residing in long-term care facilities

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: For nursing homes only, the Department of Health and Human Services shall develop a Medication Technician Certification Program.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse, registered nurse, or licensed practical nurse is responsible for the delegation and supervision of nursing tasks to unlicensed assistive personnel.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: An employer, including an agency, or supervisor of nurses, shall report any instances of the misconduct or the incapacities described in Section 40-33-110 to the State Board of Nursing not more than fifteen business days

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Nurse Licensure Compact is hereby enacted into law and entered into by this State with all other states legally joining therein

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered or a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN) issued by a home state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: "Alternative program" means a nondisciplinary monitoring program approved by a licensing board.

rn_death_pronouncement_authorized.quote: pronounce death, certify the manner and cause of death, and sign death certificates pursuant to the provisions of Chapter 63, Title 44 and Chapter 8, Title 32

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: An APRN may perform medical acts via telemedicine pursuant to a practice agreement without requiring a separate medical license. An APRN may not establish a nurse-patient relationship by telemedicine for prescribing when an in-person physical examination is necessary for diagnosis. Prescribing via telemedicine is permitted during encounters where threshold information is obtained through a medical history interview; Schedule II-V prescriptions require a practice agreement.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: An APRN may not establish a nurse-patient relationship by means of telemedicine for the purpose of prescribing medication when an in-person physical examination is necessary for diagnosis.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: A CRNA must practice in accordance with approved written guidelines developed under supervision of a licensed physician or dentist or approved by the medical staff within the facility where practice privileges have been granted.

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: is limited to drugs and devices utilized to treat medical problems within the specialty field of the nurse practitioner or clinical nurse specialist as prescribed in the practice agreement

military_education_credit_required.quote: A professional or occupational board or commission governed by this title shall accept the education, training, and experience completed by an individual as a member of the Armed Forces or Reserves of the United States
